preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Split inspections by purpose, suppress unnecessary untracked enumeration where appropriate, and use a measured sixty-second ceiling without weakening the underlying check.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Use single-purpose commands and an envelope above the observed scan duration; never promote a timed-out batch as evidence.
preferred_methods.rollback: Discard only the incomplete command result, retain its negative receipt, and reread authoritative Git or runner state directly.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Repository inspection ergonomics only; not a validation waiver or scientific, security, or authority claim.
preferred_methods.title: Bounded command envelopes for large repository inspection
trigger_preconditions: multiple inspections sharing one short envelope

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Use a literal single-quoted ripgrep pattern and one bounded target file per structural inspection.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Keep regular expressions literal in PowerShell and avoid nested JSON quotation in composite commands.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the parse failure, make no file change, and retry the read-only query with literal quoting.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Shell-query construction only; not general proof of command safety or validation completeness.
preferred_methods.title: Literal PowerShell patterns for bounded ripgrep inspection
trigger_preconditions: regular expression with quote-like JSON syntax
multiple patterns embedded in one shell string

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Record one witness, inspect its returned method_state, and request preferred only when the witness has already produced validated.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Do not batch witness and redundant validated transitions; branch the next operation on the runner's returned state.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the rejected transition, leave the witness and current valid state intact, and issue no compensating edit to the append-only ledger.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Method Flow runner sequencing only; not evidence for repository completeness or any scientific or authority claim.
preferred_methods.title: State-aware Method Flow witness promotion
trigger_preconditions: caller assumes witness and validated transition are separate
state operations batched before returned state is inspected

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Recursively decode the full inherited ledger and compare both normalized titles and canonicalized URLs before assigning a new source ID; reuse the inherited ID when either identifies the same source.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Require zero duplicate normalized titles and zero duplicate canonical URLs for every added source slate.
preferred_methods.rollback: Remove only the uncommitted duplicate additions, preserve the failed builder receipt as a negative, and keep inherited ledger rows unchanged.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Source-ledger identity only; matching a source does not validate its claims, supply observations, or delegate authority.
preferred_methods.title: Dual-key inherited source-ledger deduplication
trigger_preconditions: official specification with multiple stable URLs
candidate comparison limited to URL identity

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Give every expected non-self artifact a direct writer and exclude only the explicitly named terminal validation JSON and Markdown outputs from the prewrite presence gate.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Require a writer-or-input map for expected files and keep the deferred self-output set minimal, named, and verified after process completion.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the incomplete build receipt, revert only the unpromoted builder correction if it hides a real missing file, and never weaken privacy or exact-file review.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Builder dependency ordering only; terminal self-output deferral cannot excuse a genuinely missing input or evidence file.
preferred_methods.title: Direct writer map and deferred self-output gate
trigger_preconditions: terminal validation writes after presence calculation
expected receipt names inherited without direct writers

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Carry exact boundary vocabulary into generated receipts and tests for canonical role, named lane, same-owner replay, and independent-reproduction limits.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Treat frozen role labels as schema values rather than prose synonyms and mutation-test their presence.
preferred_methods.rollback: Restore the prior receipt only if the exact term misstates evidence; otherwise retain the failed test and regenerate the bounded receipt.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Receipt vocabulary and validator alignment only; exact words do not manufacture missing evidence or authority.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Generate the committed-byte seal from exact Git blob bytes after repository attributes and clean filters, and name that domain explicitly.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Every hash receipt must declare Git-blob, normalized logical-text, or raw working-tree domain; staged parity may compare only the Git-blob domain.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the mismatching review, restore the previous seal only as an explicitly raw-working-tree receipt if needed, and never relabel one hash domain as another.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Committed-byte manifest portability only; no cryptographic signature, exhaustive integrity, security certification, or independent reproduction.
preferred_methods.title: Exact Git-blob hash domain for committed content seals

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Pipe a literal PowerShell here-string to python standard input for multi-line read-only queries.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Select shell-native multi-line transport before composing inline code and keep the query read-only.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the parser failure, make no file change, and rerun only through the host shell's supported literal transport.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Inline read-only query transport only; not a general shell-safety or validation-completeness claim.
preferred_methods.title: PowerShell here-string transport for inline Python

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Use subprocess communicate semantics to drain input and output concurrently, then parse the complete byte stream deterministically.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Never implement high-volume bidirectional subprocess exchange as write-all then read-all on bounded pipes.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain all timeout and failed-witness evidence, restore single-object reads if batch parsing changes any digest, and compare the same full manifest.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Subprocess transport only; all manifest entries and validation gates remain unchanged.
preferred_methods.title: Communicate-backed bidirectional Git batch transport

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Retain the failed witness and rejection, move each failed candidate to deprecated as the transition graph permits, and name the preferred replacement in the transition note without rewriting history.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Read the current-state transition graph before mutation and require every failed candidate to end in an allowed terminal state.
preferred_methods.rollback: If a deprecated method later needs reconsideration, create a new candidate with explicit lineage; never reopen or rewrite the terminal record.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Method-state hygiene only; deprecation preserves failure and does not broaden the preferred transport's evidence scope.
preferred_methods.title: Transition-graph-aligned failed-candidate deprecation
